title: TINS SPEC.md (minimal viable shape)
description: The minimum viable structure a TINS consumer's SPEC.md must satisfy. The full spec can have more sections, but the ones listed here are required. Validated by the kit's validate.mjs §8.1.

title.description: The spec's title (the H1 of SPEC.md).

predecessor_documents.description: List of predecessor docs (e.g. 'archive/SPEC-v1.md'). The §0.0 footer.

what_i_guessed.description: The §0.3 'What I guessed' appendix. Each entry is an assumption the spec author made that the user should verify before implementation starts.

sections.description: The required sections. Each must be present (can be 'see <other file>' as a stub).

present.description: Whether the section is present in the SPEC.md (vs. referenced from elsewhere).

acceptance_criteria.description: The §8 acceptance criteria. Each must be runnable (a command, a curl, a test, or a 'see file X' reference).

out_of_scope.description: The §9 out-of-scope list. Each entry is something explicitly NOT built in v1.
